warnings: Columns C6, C8, C11, C12, C16 share one column of the table, C4A and C6A another. Bands ฐานราก / พื้นชั้น 1 / พื้นชั้น 2 / คานอะเส / หลังคา.

C6..C16: 0.30 4ø20 from the footing to floor 1, then 0.20 4ø20; the พื้นชั้น 2 band is an arrow and the top band is split (dash | arrow) with no legend — the upper entry runs to the roof and is flagged. C4A/C6A print dashes above floor 1's band, so they stop at floor 2.
Tie spacing is not in the table: @0.10 within 0.50 of each beam/footing, @0.20 between (seismic confinement detail on the same sheet). spacing_mm records the 0.10 end zone.
CN (0.15 4ø12 ป ø6@0.075) rises from floor 1 to the stair landing; it is drawn on S-04, which was not extracted, so CN has no position here.
